about.free: About window paragraph under the buttons. Product name Backseat stays untranslated.
about.license: About window footer; {license} = license name, e.g. MIT.
about.licenseFull: About window footer link that opens the LICENSE file.
about.reportProblem: About window button (opens the GitHub issues page), one of three in a row. Keep short.
about.support: About window button (donate / sponsor the project), one of three in a row. Keep short; keep the ☕ emoji.
about.thirdParty: About window footer link that opens THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
about.viewOnGithub: About window button, one of three in a row in a 420 px wide window. Keep short.
agents.claudeApp: Send-target label (editor target menu, status bar): the Claude desktop app. Keep the product name.
agents.codexApp: Send-target label: the Codex / ChatGPT desktop app. Keep the product names and the dot.
agents.instruction.mcp: One-line instruction pasted into the agent's terminal/chat when the agent is connected through MCP (an AI agent reads it). Keep backseat_get and the quoted {id} exactly. {id} = send id, {brief} = absolute path of brief.md.
agents.instruction.paths: One-line instruction pasted into the agent's terminal/chat (an AI agent reads it, imperative). {brief} and {image} = absolute file paths.
agents.terminal: Send-target label: a terminal window without a recognised agent. {process} = executable name, e.g. WindowsTerminal.exe.
agents.terminalAgent: Send-target label: an agent running in a terminal window. {agent} = agent name such as Claude Code (not translated).
agents.webChat: Send-target label: a browser window showing an AI chat. {title} = page title cut to 30 characters.
agents.window: Send-target label for any other window. {title} = window title cut to 30 characters, {process} = executable name.
app.tagline: About window tagline under the app name. Must not suggest the AI starts working by itself: Backseat only passes on what the user marked and said.
brief.activeWindow: brief.md line. The window that had focus before the capture hotkey. {title} = window title, {process} = executable name. Read by an AI agent.
brief.annotation.arrow: brief.md annotation line label (arrow). One short word.
brief.annotation.blur: brief.md annotation line label (blur that hides content).
brief.annotation.number: brief.md annotation line label (numbered badge). {n} = the badge number the user placed.
brief.annotation.pen: brief.md annotation line label (freehand stroke). One short word.
brief.annotation.rect: brief.md annotation line label (rectangle). One short word.
brief.annotation.text: brief.md annotation line label (text annotation). One short word; followed by an optional style note and the quoted text.
brief.annotations.heading: brief.md section heading (the code adds '## ') above the numbered list of annotations.
brief.capture: brief.md capture description line, read by an AI agent. {mode} = brief.mode.*; {what} = optional ' "window title" (process.exe)' (starts with a space, may be empty); {display} = display id; {x},{y},{w},{h} = region in DIP; {pw},{ph} = size in px; {scale} = display scale factor; {scroll} = optional ' · …' text from brief.scroll (may be empty). Keep DIP and px.
brief.compare: brief.md line, present when the user compared with the previous capture. {id} = previous session folder name, {mode} = brief.compare.overlay/wipe/diff, {percent} = percentage of changed pixels. Keep annotated.png.
brief.compare.diff: Before/after comparison mode name inside brief.compare ({mode}). Same word as the editor's compare mode.
brief.compare.overlay: Before/after comparison mode name inside brief.compare ({mode}). Same word as the editor's compare mode.
brief.compare.wipe: Brief line, compare mode name: previous capture left of a vertical line, current right. Lower case in en.
brief.crop: brief.md line, present only when the user cropped. {x},{y} = top-left of the kept area, {w}×{h} = its size, in px of the uncropped capture. Read by an AI agent.
brief.globals.heading: brief.md section heading (the code adds '## ') above speech lines that belong to no annotation.
brief.interp.blur: brief.md reading-guide bullet (the code adds '- '), only when the capture has a blur annotation.
brief.interp.coords: brief.md reading-guide bullet (the code adds '- '), read by an AI agent. Keep annotated.png and the arrow.
brief.interp.heading: brief.md section heading (the code adds '## ') for the reading guide at the end.
brief.interp.speech: brief.md reading-guide bullet (the code adds '- '), only when there is speech. The quoted words must be the pointing words (this/here) of the language the sentence is written in. Keep 🗣.
brief.memo.heading: brief.md section heading (the code adds '## ') above the user's one-line note about the whole image.
brief.mode.full: brief.md capture line, {mode} of brief.capture: capture mode 'full screen'.
brief.mode.region: brief.md capture line, {mode} of brief.capture: capture mode 'region'.
brief.mode.scroll: brief.md capture line, {mode} of brief.capture: capture mode 'scrolling capture'.
brief.mode.window: brief.md capture line, {mode} of brief.capture: capture mode 'window'.
brief.notice: brief.md line 2 (blockquote, read by an AI agent). Warns that the drawn marks are user annotations, not part of the screen. Keep the quoted letter B.
brief.notice.original: brief.md, appended after brief.notice when the package has an un-annotated screenshot; {file} = file name such as screenshot.png. Read by an AI agent.
brief.original: brief.md line under the image. {file} = file name of the capture without annotations (screenshot.png).
brief.request.agentFallback: Used as {agent} in brief.request.title when the agent did not give its name. Lowercase noun is fine.
brief.request.title: brief.md section heading (the code adds '## ') when the capture answers a backseat_ask question. {agent} = the asking agent's name or brief.request.agentFallback.
brief.scroll.one: brief.md, tail of the capture line for scrolling captures (code puts ' · ' before it). {n} = number of stitched frames, {viewport} = height of one frame in px. Plural form.
brief.scroll.other: brief.md, tail of the capture line for scrolling captures (code puts ' · ' before it). {n} = number of stitched frames, {viewport} = height of one frame in px. Plural form.
brief.speech.auto: brief.md, in parentheses at the end of a speech line (🗣): automatically aligned with this confidence. {confidence} = number 0.00-1.00.
brief.speech.manual: brief.md, in parentheses at the end of a speech line (🗣): the user linked this sentence to the annotation by hand.
brief.target: brief.md line. {label} = display name of the window/agent the package is sent to (already in the UI language).
brief.textStyle.bold: brief.md style note for a text annotation, shown in parentheses and joined with '·' (e.g. '(bold·italic)'). One lowercase word.
brief.textStyle.italic: brief.md style note for a text annotation, shown in parentheses and joined with '·'. One lowercase word.
brief.textStyle.normal: brief.md style note for a text annotation that is explicitly not bold, shown in parentheses and joined with '·'.
brief.textStyle.shadow: brief.md style note for a text annotation, shown in parentheses and joined with '·'. One lowercase word.
brief.uiux.aim: brief.md UI/UX section heading: the final resolved design values.
brief.uiux.aim.box: brief.md UI/UX section: {minWidth} and {maxWidth} may be the text of brief.uiux.unset.
brief.uiux.aim.colors: brief.md UI/UX section: {list} is "role #RRGGBB" items separated by commas; role names are identifiers and stay in English.
brief.uiux.aim.ratio: brief.md UI/UX section: heuristic share of the three color layers in the marked area; must read as a target.
brief.uiux.aim.shadows: brief.md UI/UX section: {list} is "role values" items separated by semicolons.
brief.uiux.aim.type: brief.md UI/UX section: {list} is "role values" items separated by semicolons.
brief.uiux.basis.agent: brief.md UI/UX section: basis of the project overview (agent analysis).
brief.uiux.basis.imported: brief.md UI/UX section: basis of the project overview (imported file).
brief.uiux.basis.user: brief.md UI/UX section: basis of the project overview typed by the user without an agent; tells the agent nothing was verified in the code.
brief.uiux.changes: brief.md UI/UX section heading: token changes. Paths such as colors.primary stay as they are.
brief.uiux.checks.note: brief.md UI/UX section: instruction to the agent.
brief.uiux.checks.runtime: brief.md UI/UX section: sub-heading for checks that a picture cannot prove.
brief.uiux.checks.visual: brief.md UI/UX section: sub-heading for contrast, alignment, clipping checks.
brief.uiux.component.button: brief.md UI/UX section: component type the change is limited to (plural noun, used inside the scope sentence).
brief.uiux.component.card: brief.md UI/UX section: component type, see brief.uiux.component.button.
brief.uiux.component.input: brief.md UI/UX section: component type, see brief.uiux.component.button.
brief.uiux.component.table: brief.md UI/UX section: component type, see brief.uiux.component.button.
brief.uiux.conflicts: brief.md UI/UX section heading: e.g. the note contradicts a locked rule.
brief.uiux.done: brief.md UI/UX section: last line, instruction to the agent.
brief.uiux.heading: brief.md: heading of the UI/UX section, only present when the user applied guidance to this send.
brief.uiux.intro: brief.md: first line of the UI/UX section, read by the agent.
brief.uiux.locks: brief.md UI/UX section heading: token paths the user locked.
brief.uiux.overview: brief.md UI/UX section: which project overview the guidance rests on. {basis} is one of the brief.uiux.basis.* texts, {revision} a number.
brief.uiux.overview.noRevision: brief.md UI/UX section: same as brief.uiux.overview when no revision number is known.
brief.uiux.preserve: brief.md UI/UX section heading: things that must not change.
brief.uiux.preview: brief.md UI/UX section: only when a mock-up is in the package. {file} is design-preview.png.
brief.uiux.previewMissing: brief.md UI/UX section: a mock-up was sent but rejected (not a valid PNG, too large or wrong size).
brief.uiux.proposal: brief.md UI/UX section: id of the proposal the user picked.
brief.uiux.purpose: brief.md UI/UX section: one or two sentence purpose summary of the project.
brief.uiux.report: brief.md, last line of the UI/UX section, only when the send has an implementation_report job. {jobId} = the job id. Text an AI agent reads (brief language). Keep the tool name backseat_job_submit.
brief.uiux.rules: brief.md UI/UX section: revision number of the project design rules used.
brief.uiux.scope.all: brief.md UI/UX section: where the change applies.
brief.uiux.scope.annotations: brief.md UI/UX section: where the change applies; {refs} are the circled numbers of the annotation list above, comma separated.
brief.uiux.scope.component: brief.md UI/UX section: where the change applies; {component} is a brief.uiux.component.* text.
brief.uiux.scope.unlinked: brief.md UI/UX section: replaces an annotation number when that annotation was deleted after the scope was set; also used when the scope names no annotation at all.
brief.uiux.skill: brief.md UI/UX section: design skill behind the values. {source} is one of brief.uiux.skill.source.*.
brief.uiux.skill.source.imported: brief.md UI/UX section: skill source (text and data only, never run by Backseat).
brief.uiux.unset: brief.md UI/UX section: a value that was not given (also the "from" side of a new value).
brief.uiux.value.none: brief.md UI/UX section: a value that is explicitly empty, e.g. no shadow.
brief.voice: brief.md line when speech was recorded. {seconds} = duration with one decimal (e.g. 12.3), {model} = speech model name. Keep transcript.json.
brief.voiceMissing: brief.md line (read by an AI agent) when the user sent a recording whose transcription failed.
colorpicker.custom: Tooltip and accessible name of the small '+' swatch that opens the system color chooser.
colorpicker.dialog: Accessible name (aria-label) of the color picker popover; not visible.
colorpicker.eyedropper: Button label next to an eyedropper icon (pick a color from the screen). Short: the button is about 100 px wide.
colorpicker.eyedropperAria: Accessible name (aria-label) of the eyedropper button; not visible.
colorpicker.hexCode: Accessible name (aria-label) of the text field where a color like #RRGGBB is typed; not visible.
colorpicker.noRecent: Shown in the recent-colors row when no color has been used yet.
colorpicker.recent: Small label in front of the row of recently used colors. One short word.
dialog.macScreenPermission.detail: macOS dialog detail: where to switch it on. Use the names macOS itself shows in this language for System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen & System Audio Recording. Backseat must be quit and reopened afterwards.
dialog.macScreenPermission.later: macOS dialog button that closes the dialog without capturing.
dialog.macScreenPermission.message: macOS dialog main text: capturing needs the Screen Recording permission.
dialog.macScreenPermission.open: macOS dialog button that opens the Screen Recording settings pane.
dialog.macScreenPermission.title: macOS dialog title when the Screen Recording permission is denied. Short.
dialog.saveCapture: Title bar of the save-as dialog for the annotated PNG.
dialog.saveVideo: Title bar of the save-as dialog for the WebM/MP4 replay of the drawing session.
editor.action.close: Bottom bar button after a send: closes the editor. Short.
editor.action.confirmTarget: Bottom bar button after editor.stop.targetChanged: the user confirms the window is right and sends again into it. Short.
editor.action.copy: Bottom bar button after a send: copies the image and description to the clipboard to paste by hand. Short.
editor.action.copyTip: Tooltip of the Copy button in the bottom bar. One sentence.
editor.action.newCapture: Bottom bar button after a send: starts a new screen capture. Short.
editor.action.resend: Bottom bar button after a send: sends the current capture again. Short.
editor.action.retarget: Bottom bar button after a send: opens the destination menu. Short.
editor.ask.label: Bar above the image when this capture answers an agent's question. {agent} = agent name, {question} = its question. Usually unchanged.
editor.chip.guess: State in the destination chip: Backseat guessed the destination (the AI app that was in front). Must say it is a guess. One word.
editor.chip.none: Destination chip text when there is no safe destination. Clicking it opens the destination menu.
editor.chip.noneTip: Tooltip of the destination chip when no destination is set. One sentence.
editor.chip.picked: State in the destination chip: the user picked this window in the destination menu. Short.
editor.chip.pinned: State in the destination chip: this window is the pinned default destination. Short.
editor.chip.recent: State in the destination chip: Backseat guessed the destination because it is the AI window the user used last. Must say it is a guess. Short.
editor.chip.unavailable: Destination chip when the window the user picked or pinned is not open. {label} = that window's name. Followed by a second line: choose again.
editor.chip.verified: State in the destination chip of the main row, after the destination name: the AI agent's connection to Backseat was confirmed. Short.
editor.color.titleFor: Title of the color popover opened from the options row. {tool} = the tool's name, e.g. 'Pen', 'Arrow'.
editor.compare.after: Small label drawn on the image right of the wipe line (current capture). Very short (about 6 characters): drawn in a small box on the canvas.
editor.compare.available: Status bar text when the editor opens and a previous capture of the same region exists. O is a shortcut key, keep it.
editor.compare.before: Small label drawn on the image left of the wipe line (previous capture). Very short (about 6 characters): drawn in a small box on the canvas.
editor.compare.close: First button of the before/after comparison bar: turns the comparison off (also O or Esc).
editor.compare.diff: Comparison mode button and mode name (shows only what changed). Short.
editor.compare.diffLabel: Right side of the compare bar. {percent} = share of pixels that differ, a number like 3.2.
editor.compare.diffTip: Tooltip of the Difference comparison mode button.
editor.compare.label: Accessible name of the before/after comparison bar.
editor.compare.modes: Accessible name of the group of comparison mode buttons.
editor.compare.none: Status bar text when O is pressed but there is no previous capture. {item} = the tray menu item name (Recapture last region).
editor.compare.off: Status bar text after turning the comparison off.
editor.compare.opacity: Label of the slider that sets the overlay opacity in the compare bar. Short.
editor.compare.overlay: Comparison mode button and mode name (previous capture laid over the current one, semi-transparent). Short.
editor.compare.overlayTip: Tooltip of the Overlay comparison mode button.
editor.compare.position: Label of the slider that moves the wipe line in the compare bar. Short.
editor.compare.status: Status bar text while comparison is on. {mode} = the mode name (Overlay / Wipe / Difference). O is a shortcut key, keep it.
editor.compare.toggle: Button in the compare bar that turns the before/after comparison on or off. Short.
editor.compare.wipe: Compare-bar button, very short: a vertical line splits previous capture (left) and current capture (right).
editor.compare.wipeTip: Tooltip of the Wipe comparison mode button.
editor.debug.addAnnotations: Debug/self-test only: name of an undo step. Not shown to normal users.
editor.debug.transcriptInjected: Debug/self-test only: status bar text. {count} = number of transcript segments.
editor.delivery.clipboardChosen: Bottom bar after a clipboard-only send.
editor.delivery.failed: Bottom bar when nothing could be sent.
editor.delivery.fetched: Bottom bar after the connected AI agent fetched the capture. Must not say it understood or finished the work.
editor.delivery.fetchedBy: Same as editor.delivery.fetched with the agent's name. {name} = e.g. 'Claude Code'.
editor.delivery.fetchedOther: Bottom bar: an agent other than the chosen destination fetched the capture. {name} = that agent's name.
editor.delivery.noTarget: Bottom bar after Send when no destination was set: the capture was saved and copied, nothing was pasted.
editor.delivery.notFetched: Bottom bar when the connected AI did not fetch the capture within a few minutes. Short; followed by a 'Send again' button.
editor.delivery.pasted: Bottom bar after Send pasted into the AI window. Must read as an attempt; the user still has to press Enter/submit there. Never say delivered or done.
editor.delivery.pastedEnter: Bottom bar after Send pasted and pressed Enter (auto-Enter setting). Must read as an attempt; never say delivered, sent or done.
editor.delivery.saved: Bottom bar when only the capture package was written.
editor.delivery.sending: Bottom bar while Send is running.
editor.delivery.stepsLabel: Accessible name of the list of delivery step chips.
editor.delivery.waitFetch: Bottom bar detail after pasting to an AI connected through Backseat: waiting for it to fetch the capture.
editor.font.blackHanSans: Font drop-down entry: display name of the Korean font Black Han Sans.
editor.font.doHyeon: Font drop-down entry: display name of the Korean font Do Hyeon.
editor.font.jua: Font drop-down entry: display name of the Korean font Jua.
editor.font.nanumGothic: Font drop-down entry: display name of the Korean font Nanum Gothic. Transliterate or keep the Latin name.
editor.font.nanumPen: Font drop-down entry: display name of the Korean handwriting font Nanum Pen Script.
editor.font.system: Font drop-down entry: the system UI font.
editor.history.arrow: Name of an undo step: an arrow was drawn.
editor.history.badge: Name of an undo step: a numbered badge was placed.
editor.history.blur: Name of an undo step: a blur region was added.
editor.history.crop: Name of an undo step: the image was cropped.
editor.history.erase: Name of an undo step: annotations were erased with the eraser.
editor.history.linkAdd: Name of an undo step: a speech line was linked to an annotation in the timeline (glossary: link).
editor.history.linkRemove: Name of an undo step: a speech line was unlinked from an annotation.
editor.history.pen: Name of an undo step: a pen stroke was drawn. Appears inside the undo/redo tooltip.
editor.history.rect: Name of an undo step: a rectangle was drawn.
editor.history.redoTip: Tooltip of the redo button when there is something to redo. {label} = the step's name. Keep Ctrl+Shift+Z.
editor.history.text: Name of an undo step: a text annotation was added.
editor.history.textEdit: Name of an undo step: a text annotation was edited.
editor.history.textMove: Name of an undo step: a text annotation was moved.
editor.history.undoTip: Tooltip of the undo button when there is something to undo. {label} = the step's name (editor.history.* e.g. Pen, Crop). Keep Ctrl+Z.
editor.hotkey.badge: Command name (select the numbered badge tool).
editor.hotkey.blur: Tooltip / shortcut name of the hide (pixelate) tool, shown as 'Hide (B)'.
editor.hotkey.close: Command name (close the editor), shortcut Esc.
editor.hotkey.compare: Command name / tooltip of the compare toggle button, followed by the shortcut O.
editor.hotkey.copy: Command name in a tooltip, followed by the shortcut.
editor.hotkey.home: Command name (timeline: jump to the start), shortcut Home.
editor.hotkey.live: Command name (timeline: jump back to the live editing state), shortcut End.
editor.hotkey.mic: Command name / tooltip of the microphone record button, followed by the shortcut M.
editor.hotkey.pin: Command name / tooltip of the pin button (keep the editor on top as a small reference window), followed by the shortcut Ctrl+P.
editor.hotkey.redo: Command name in the redo button tooltip, followed by the shortcut; also the redo button's accessible name.
editor.hotkey.save: Command name in a tooltip, followed by the shortcut.
editor.hotkey.send: Tooltip name of the Send button, shown as 'Send (Enter)'.
editor.hotkey.stepBack: Command name (timeline: step back 0.2 seconds), shortcut Left arrow.
editor.hotkey.stepFwd: Command name (timeline: step forward 0.2 seconds), shortcut Right arrow.
editor.hotkey.target: Command name / tooltip of the target bar button, followed by the shortcut Ctrl+T.
editor.hotkey.timeline: Command name / tooltip of the timeline button, followed by the shortcut L.
editor.hotkey.undo: Command name in the undo button tooltip, followed by the shortcut; also the undo button's accessible name.
editor.hotkey.video: Command name / tooltip of the timeline "Save video" button (Ctrl+E): exports the drawing replay as a video file.
editor.hotkey.widthDown: Tooltip / shortcut name of the [ key: makes the selected tool's line width, number size or blur strength one step smaller.
editor.hotkey.widthUp: Tooltip / shortcut name of the ] key: makes the selected tool's line width, number size or blur strength one step larger.
editor.memo.placeholder: Placeholder of the note field at the bottom of the editor.
editor.mic.downloading: Status bar text while the speech model downloads. {file} = file name (may be empty), {percent} = integer 0-100.
editor.mic.label: Microphone button in the main row (next to a 🎤 icon): starts recording a spoken explanation. Short (one word).
editor.mic.loadingModel: Status bar text while the speech recognition model loads.
editor.mic.noSound: Status bar error when the recording is empty.
editor.mic.processing: Status bar text while the recording is decoded before transcription.
editor.mic.readFailed: Status bar error. {error} = technical error message.
editor.mic.recordError: Status bar error from the recorder.
editor.mic.startFailed: Status bar error. {error} = technical error message.
editor.mic.stop: Toolbar button text while recording. Keep ■. {time} = elapsed time mm:ss. Very short: toolbar is 820 px wide.
editor.mic.stopFailed: Status bar error. {error} = technical error message.
editor.mic.transcribeError: Status bar error when the speech engine reported an error without a message.
editor.mic.transcribeFailed: Status bar error. {error} = technical error message.
editor.mic.transcribed.one: Status bar text after transcription (singular). {n} = number of words.
editor.mic.transcribed.other: Status bar text after transcription (plural). {n} = number of words.
editor.mic.transcribing: Status bar text while speech is transcribed.
editor.mic.unavailable: Status bar error. {error} = technical error message.
editor.more.label: Accessible name of the ⋯ button in the main row that opens the menu with crop, eraser, timeline, comparison, pin, copy, save and video.
editor.more.pin: Item in the ⋯ menu: keeps the editor window always on top (small reference window). Has a check mark when on.
editor.more.tip: Tooltip of the ⋯ button in the main row. One sentence.
editor.opt.badgeNext: Hint in the number tool's options: the number the next click will place. {n} = a number.
editor.opt.blurHint: Hint at the end of the hide tool's options row. Hidden when the row is short of space.
editor.opt.blurMediumTip: Tooltip of the medium strength button of the hide tool. One sentence.
editor.opt.blurSolidTip: Tooltip of the solid strength button of the hide tool. One sentence.
editor.opt.blurStrongTip: Tooltip of the strong strength button of the hide tool. One sentence.
editor.opt.cropApply: Button in the crop tool's options: crops to the dragged area (also Enter). Short.
editor.opt.cropCancel: Button in the crop tool's options: drops the dragged area (also Esc). Short.
editor.opt.cropHint: Hint in the crop tool's options row, before the Apply and Cancel buttons.
editor.opt.eraserHint: Hint shown in the options row while the eraser is selected. Keep Ctrl+Z.
editor.opt.label: Accessible name of the second row, which shows only the selected tool's options.
editor.opt.large: Size choice of the number tool. Short.
editor.opt.medium: Size choice of the number tool and strength choice of the hide tool (the default). Short.
editor.opt.size: Label before the size buttons of the number tool (numbered circles).
editor.opt.small: Size choice of the number tool. Short.
editor.opt.solid: Strength choice of the hide tool: covers the area with one solid color. Short.
editor.opt.strength: Label before the strength buttons of the hide (pixelate) tool.
editor.opt.strong: Strength choice of the hide tool: coarser mosaic. Short.
editor.opt.textMore: Button at the end of the text tool's options that opens a row with background color, opacity, swap, outline and shadow. Very short (one word); followed by an arrow ▸.
editor.opt.textMoreDone: Button at the end of the text details row: folds the row away again.
editor.opt.textMoreTip: Tooltip of the Details button of the text tool. One sentence.
editor.status.colorPicked: Status bar text after picking a colour. {color} = hex code like #E5484D.
editor.status.copied: Status bar text after copying the image.
editor.status.copyFailed: Status bar error. {error} = technical error message.
editor.status.cropPending: Status line after dragging a crop area. Keep Enter and Esc.
editor.status.cropped: Status bar text after cropping. {w} and {h} = new size in pixels. Keep px and Ctrl+Z.
editor.status.croppedDropped.one: Status bar text after cropping when annotations outside the crop were removed (singular). {w}, {h} = new size in px, {n} = number removed.
editor.status.croppedDropped.other: Status bar text after cropping when annotations outside the crop were removed (plural). {w}, {h} = new size in px, {n} = number removed.
editor.status.erased.one: Status bar text after erasing (singular). {n} = number of annotations erased.
editor.status.erased.other: Status bar text after erasing (plural). {n} = number of annotations erased.
editor.status.imageFailed: Status bar error when the captured image cannot be shown.
editor.status.pickCanceled: Status bar text when the eyedropper was canceled.
editor.status.pickColor: Status bar text while the eyedropper is active. Keep Esc.
editor.status.pickTarget: Status bar when 전송 is pressed again before a new destination was picked (after the picked window closed). The target menu opens.
editor.status.pinFailed: Status bar error. {error} = technical error message.
editor.status.pinned: Status bar text after pinning the editor. Keep Ctrl+P.
editor.status.saveCanceled: Status bar text when the user closed the save dialog.
editor.status.saveFailed: Status bar error. {error} = technical error message.
editor.status.saved: Status bar text after saving. {path} = file path.
editor.status.sendCanceled: Status bar after the user chose Cancel in the speech recognition failure question.
editor.status.sendFailed: Status bar error. {error} = technical error message.
editor.status.unknownError: Used as {error} in save/copy/video/transcription errors when no message was given.
editor.status.unpinned: Status bar text after unpinning the editor.
editor.status.voiceMissing: Status line when Send is pressed while the recording has no text. Nothing was sent.
editor.step.clipboard: Delivery step chip: the image and text are on the clipboard. Very short.
editor.step.fetched: Delivery step chip: the AI agent fetched the capture through Backseat. Must not say the AI understood or finished anything. Very short.
editor.step.inputVerified: Delivery step chip: the focused spot was confirmed to be a normal input box (not a password field). Very short.
editor.step.pasted: Delivery step chip: Ctrl+V was sent. Must read as an attempt, never as delivered or done. Very short.
editor.step.saved: Delivery step chip in the bottom bar after Send (shown with a check mark only when confirmed): the capture package was written. Very short.
editor.step.targetVerified: Delivery step chip: the destination window was confirmed and came to the front. Very short.
editor.stop.confirmDetail: What to do after editor.stop.targetChanged. Names the button editor.action.confirmTarget: keep the same words for it.
editor.stop.error: Bottom bar: an error stopped sending.
editor.stop.errorWith: Same as editor.stop.error with the error text. {error} = error message.
editor.stop.focusLost: Bottom bar: focus changed between the check and the paste, so nothing was pasted.
editor.stop.notEditable: Bottom bar: the focused element in the destination window is not a text input, so nothing was pasted.
editor.stop.passwordField: Bottom bar: the focused element is a password field; Backseat never pastes there.
editor.stop.pasteByHand: What to do after a paste was not attempted: the capture is on the clipboard. Keep Ctrl+V.
editor.stop.pasteUnsupported: Bottom bar headline: this operating system (macOS / Linux) cannot paste automatically; nothing was pasted. The next line (editor.stop.pasteUnsupportedDetail) tells the user to paste by hand.
editor.stop.pasteUnsupportedDetail: Bottom bar detail after editor.stop.pasteUnsupported: the capture is on the clipboard; paste it in the AI window. Keep Cmd+V (macOS) and Ctrl+V (Linux).
editor.stop.pickAgain: What to do after the destination closed.
editor.stop.targetChanged: Bottom bar after Send: the destination window now shows another title (maybe another tab or chat), so nothing was pasted. The clipboard is ready.
editor.stop.targetExpired: Bottom bar: the destination window closed before sending; nothing was sent.
editor.stop.tryAgain: What to do after an error.
editor.stop.uiaUnavailable: Bottom bar: Backseat could not check the focused element, so it did not paste.
editor.summary.annotations.one: Bottom bar item: number of marks drawn on the image. {n} = number.
editor.summary.changed: Faint note at the end of the bottom bar: the user edited after the last send, so the changes were not sent yet.
editor.summary.image.one: Bottom bar item: number of images that will be sent. {n} = number.
editor.summary.label: Label at the start of the bottom bar, before the list of what Send will deliver (image, annotations, note, voice). Short.
editor.summary.memo: Bottom bar item: the one-line note will be sent too. One word.
editor.summary.retryVoice: Bottom bar button: tries again to turn the recording into text. Short.
editor.summary.voiceLinks: Link in the bottom bar after speech was turned into text: opens the timeline to check which sentence belongs to which mark.
editor.summary.voiceMissing: Bottom bar warning when the recording could not be turned into text. Followed by two buttons: convert again / send without voice.
editor.summary.voiceReady: Bottom bar item: the spoken explanation was turned into text and will be sent.
editor.summary.voiceRecording: Bottom bar item while the microphone records.
editor.summary.voiceTranscribing: Bottom bar item while the recording is being turned into text.
editor.summary.withoutVoice: Bottom bar button: sends the capture without the spoken explanation. Short.
editor.target.agentFallback: Name shown when an agent asking the user a question did not give its own name.
editor.target.chipAuto: Chip of the first target menu row for the automatically detected target. Very short.
editor.target.chipClipboard: Chip of the last target menu row ('clipboard only'). Very short.
editor.target.chipPinned: Chip of the first target menu row when the default target is pinned. Very short.
editor.target.clipboardOnly: Last target menu row and target bar label: write the package and copy it, without focusing or pasting into any window.
editor.target.expiredNote: Target bar text after a send was refused because the picked window had closed.
editor.target.hintClipboard: Small hint (target bar and menu rows): the package is only copied to the clipboard.
editor.target.hintPasteImage: Hint at the right of a target menu row: the image will be pasted.
editor.target.hintPastePath: Hint at the right of a target menu row: the session folder path will be pasted.
editor.target.kindChat: Chip in the target menu: a chat in a web browser.
editor.target.kindClaudeDesktop: Chip in the target menu: the Claude desktop app. Claude is a product name.
editor.target.kindTerminal: Chip in the target menu: a terminal window.
editor.target.kindUnknown: Chip in the target menu: any other window. Very short.
editor.target.menuLabel: Accessible name of the send-target drop-down list (the window that receives the package).
editor.target.pinDefault: Checkbox at the bottom of the target menu.
editor.target.rowAuto: First target menu row text for the automatically detected target. {label} = window/agent name.
editor.target.rowAutoNone: First target menu row text when there is no automatic destination.
editor.target.rowPinned: First target menu row text for the pinned default target. {label} = window/agent name.
editor.text.auto: Toggle button: choose the background box colour automatically. Very short.
editor.text.autoTip: Tooltip of the Auto toggle for the background box colour.
editor.text.background: Label of the background-box colour group in the text bar; also the group's accessible name.
editor.text.bgOpacity: Tooltip and accessible name of the background box opacity slider.
editor.text.effect: Label of the text-effect button group in the text bar (box / outline / none); also the group's accessible name. Short: the text bar is one row.
editor.text.effectTip: Tooltip of the text-effect button group.
editor.text.invert: Text-bar button that swaps the text colour and the background colour. Keep the ⇄ symbol. Short.
editor.text.outline: Text-effect button (dark outline around the text), and the label of the outline colour group in the text bar. Short.
editor.text.outlineColor: Tooltip / accessible name of the outline colour button, and title of its colour popover.
editor.text.outlineTip: Tooltip of the outline text-effect button. PowerPoint and Photoshop are product names.
editor.text.plain: Text-effect button: no effect, text only. Short: the text bar is one row.
editor.text.plainTip: Tooltip of the no-effect text button.
editor.text.plate: Text-effect button: text on a translucent background box (glossary: background box). Short: the text bar is one row, ~20 characters per button at most.
editor.text.plateColor: Tooltip / accessible name of the background-box colour button, and title of its colour popover.
editor.text.plateColorAuto: Tooltip of the background-box colour button while the colour is set to Auto.
editor.text.plateTip: Tooltip of the background-box text-effect button. Snagit, Canva and Instagram Stories are product names.
editor.text.sampleGlyph: Sample glyph drawn inside each text-effect button icon (about 18 px square). One or two characters of the language's script.
editor.text.shadow: Toggle button in the text bar (drop shadow), and its tooltip. Short.
editor.timeline.close: Accessible name of the ✕ button that closes the timeline panel.
editor.timeline.hint: Hint line in the timeline bar. Keep the arrows and the key name Home. About 40 characters at most.
editor.timeline.liveTip: Tooltip of the LIVE button of the timeline (jump back to the present). Keep the key name End.
editor.timeline.playTip: Tooltip of the timeline play button. Keep the key name Space.
editor.timeline.video: Timeline bar button: saves the replay of the drawing session as a video file (it does NOT start recording). Short.
editor.tool.arrow: Toolbar button (tool), shortened form. Very short: toolbar is 820 px wide.
editor.tool.badge: Toolbar button (tool) that places numbered badges, and its tooltip. Very short: toolbar is 820 px wide.
editor.tool.blur: Tool button in the editor's main row: hides (pixelates or covers) part of the capture for privacy. Short (one word).
editor.tool.crop: Toolbar button (tool) and its tooltip. Very short: toolbar is 820 px wide.
editor.tool.eraser: Toolbar button (tool). Very short: toolbar is 820 px wide.
editor.tool.pen: Toolbar button (tool) and its tooltip. Very short: toolbar is 820 px wide.
editor.tool.rect: Tool button in the editor's main row: rectangle tool. Short (one word); it is one of eight items that must fit one row.
editor.tool.text: Toolbar button (tool) and its tooltip. Very short: toolbar is 820 px wide.
editor.toolbar.boldTip: Tooltip of the bold toggle button (its visible label is the letter B).
editor.toolbar.colorGroup: Accessible name (aria-label) of the colour button group in the editor toolbar. Not visible.
editor.toolbar.copy: Toolbar button: copy the annotated image to the clipboard. Very short: toolbar is 820 px wide.
editor.toolbar.fontSizeTip: Tooltip of the font size drop-down.
editor.toolbar.historyGroup: Accessible name (aria-label) of the undo/redo button group. Not visible.
editor.toolbar.italicTip: Tooltip of the italic toggle button (its visible label is the letter I).
editor.toolbar.save: Toolbar button: save the annotated image to a file. Very short: toolbar is 820 px wide.
editor.toolbar.send: Main button that sends the capture to the AI. Short (one word), the primary action of the main row.
editor.toolbar.text: Label and accessible group name for the text font controls (font, size, bold, italic) in the second toolbar row. Very short.
editor.toolbar.timeline: Toolbar button that shows/hides the timeline panel; also the accessible name of the timeline panel. Short: toolbar is 820 px wide and must not wrap.
editor.toolbar.tools: Accessible name (aria-label) of the group of drawing tool buttons in the editor toolbar. Not visible.
editor.toolbar.width: Label of the stroke-width slider in the second toolbar row; also its group's accessible name. Very short.
editor.toolbar.widthTip: Tooltip of the width slider in the options row of the pen, arrow and rectangle tools. Keep the keys [ / ].
editor.video.canceled: Status bar text when the user closed the video save dialog.
editor.video.exporting: Status bar text while the drawing session is replayed into a WebM video. {seconds} = duration with one decimal.
editor.video.failed: Status bar error. {error} = technical error message.
editor.video.noAnnotations: Status bar text when exporting a video without any annotation.
editor.video.saved: Status bar text after saving the video. {path} = file path.
mcp.annotationNotice: MCP tool result text shown to an AI agent just before annotated.png.
mcp.askTimeout: MCP tool result for backseat_ask when the timeout passed. {seconds} = timeout in seconds, {requestId} = request id (digits and dash).
mcp.designPreview: MCP tool result text placed just before design-preview.png, which backseat_get / backseat_latest attach when includeDesignPreview is true.
mcp.files: MCP tool result header line (AI agent). {files} = comma-separated file names of the session package.
mcp.folder: MCP tool result header line (AI agent). {dir} = absolute session folder path.
mcp.job.closed.other: Reply about a cancelled, expired or failed job. {status} = cancelled, expired or failed (keep as is).
mcp.job.closed.submitted: Reply about a job that is already finished successfully.
mcp.job.gap.architecture: One missing part of a project overview, listed after mcp.job.submit.incomplete. Field names in parentheses are JSON keys.
mcp.job.gap.audiences: One missing part of a project overview, listed after mcp.job.submit.incomplete. Field names in parentheses are JSON keys.
mcp.job.gap.purpose: One missing part of a project overview, listed after mcp.job.submit.incomplete. Field names in parentheses are JSON keys.
mcp.job.gap.purposeUnbacked: One missing part of a project overview, listed after mcp.job.submit.incomplete. Field names in parentheses are JSON keys.
mcp.job.gap.summary: One missing part of a project overview, listed after mcp.job.submit.incomplete. Field names in parentheses are JSON keys.
mcp.job.gap.workflows: One missing part of a project overview, listed after mcp.job.submit.incomplete. Field names in parentheses are JSON keys.
mcp.job.header: First line of backseat_job_get and of replies about a closed job. {type} = project_overview, skill_setup, capabilities, design_proposal or style_audit (keep as is); {status} = pending, fetched, rejected, submitted, failed, cancelled or expired (keep as is); {expiresAt} = ISO time.
mcp.job.inputLabel: Label above the job input JSON in backseat_job_get.
mcp.job.lastError: backseat_job_get on a job whose last result was rejected. {error} = short list of validation errors (English technical text).
mcp.job.notFound: Reply when a job id is unknown. {jobId} = the id the agent sent.
mcp.job.rules: Rules block in backseat_job_get, read by the AI agent. The words verified, user, estimated, unknown and evidence are field values in the JSON: keep them in English.
mcp.job.schemaLabel: Label above the JSON Schema in backseat_job_get.
mcp.job.status.progress: backseat_job_status with in_progress. {status} = the job status (keep as is).
mcp.job.submit.already: backseat_job_submit when a finished job receives a different result.
mcp.job.submit.deduped: Added to the backseat_job_submit reply for design_proposal. {ids} = comma-separated proposal ids.
mcp.job.submit.duplicate: backseat_job_submit when the identical result was submitted again.
mcp.job.submit.incomplete: backseat_job_submit for a project overview that lacks required parts; followed by one line per gap (mcp.job.gap.*). {expiresAt} = ISO time.
mcp.job.submit.rejected: backseat_job_submit when validation failed; followed by one technical error line each (English).
mcp.job.submit.reportNote: Added to the backseat_job_submit reply for an accepted implementation_report.
mcp.job.submit.stale: backseat_job_submit when inputRevision does not match the job.
mcp.job.submitHow: How-to line in backseat_job_get for the AI agent. Tool names, jobId, inputRevision, result, cancelled and expired stay in English.
mcp.job.unsupportedType: Reply when a job file has an unknown type.
mcp.job.what.capabilities: Task description in backseat_job_get for job type capabilities, read by the AI agent. Field names (projectId, summary, proposals, findings, verified, ...) are JSON keys and values: keep them in English.
mcp.job.what.design_proposal: Task description in backseat_job_get for job type design_proposal, read by the AI agent. Field names (projectId, summary, proposals, findings, verified, ...) are JSON keys and values: keep them in English.
mcp.job.what.implementation_report: Task description in backseat_job_get for job type implementation_report, read by the AI agent. Field names (summary, changedFiles, notDone, checksRun, path, note, projectId) are JSON keys: keep them in English.
mcp.job.what.project_overview: Task description in backseat_job_get for job type project_overview, read by the AI agent. Field names (projectId, summary, proposals, findings, verified, ...) are JSON keys and values: keep them in English.
mcp.job.what.skill_setup: Task description in backseat_job_get for job type skill_setup, read by the AI agent. Field names (projectId, summary, proposals, findings, verified, ...) are JSON keys and values: keep them in English.
mcp.job.what.style_audit: Task description in backseat_job_get for job type style_audit, read by the AI agent. Field names (projectId, summary, proposals, findings, verified, ...) are JSON keys and values: keep them in English.
mcp.listEmpty: MCP tool result for backseat_list when the list is empty.
mcp.noDesignPreview: MCP tool result for backseat_get / backseat_latest with includeDesignPreview when the package has no design-preview.png.
mcp.noSession: MCP tool result for backseat_latest when nothing was sent yet. {root} = sessions folder. Keep the key combination Ctrl+Shift+A.
mcp.notFound: MCP tool error result for backseat_get. {id} = the requested session id.
mcp.originalScreen: MCP tool result text placed just before screenshot.png.
mcp.waitTimeout: MCP tool result for backseat_wait when the timeout passed.
palette.calm: Color picker palette tab (muted colors). One short word: four tabs share one row.
palette.mono: Color picker palette tab (grayscale). One short word: four tabs share one row.
palette.pastel: Color picker palette tab (light pastel colors). One short word: four tabs share one row.
palette.vivid: Color picker palette tab (saturated colors). One short word: four tabs share one row.
requests.agentFallback: Used as {agent} in requests.title when the agent has no name. Capitalised noun.
requests.body: Desktop notification body. {question} = the agent's question (first line), second line explains the click action.
requests.title: Desktop notification title when an agent asks the user to show something (backseat_ask). {agent} = agent name or requests.agentFallback.
scroll.badge.progress.one: Same badge while capturing. {n} = frames grabbed so far, {height} = stitched height in px. Keep short (about 220 px wide); keep Esc. Plural form.
scroll.badge.progress.other: Same badge while capturing. {n} = frames grabbed so far, {height} = stitched height in px. Keep short (about 220 px wide); keep Esc. Plural form.
scroll.badge.start: Small always-on-top badge shown during scrolling capture (about 220 px wide). Keep short; keep the key name Esc.
selector.hint.full: Hint at the top of the capture selector overlay, full screen mode. Enter and Esc are key names; keep them.
selector.hint.rect: Hint at the top of the capture selector overlay, region mode. Enter and Esc are key names; keep them.
selector.hint.scroll: Hint at the top of the capture selector overlay, scrolling capture mode. Esc is a key name; keep it.
selector.hint.window: Hint at the top of the capture selector overlay, window mode. Esc is a key name; keep it.
selector.mode.full: Capture mode button (full screen), followed by the shortcut letter F (not part of this text). Very short.
selector.mode.rect: Capture mode button in the selector bar, followed by the shortcut letter R (not part of this text). Region capture. Very short.
selector.mode.scroll: Capture mode button (scrolling capture), followed by the shortcut letter S (not part of this text). Very short.
selector.mode.window: Capture mode button, followed by the shortcut letter W (not part of this text). Very short.
selector.scrollLabel: Label next to the highlighted window in scrolling-capture mode. {label} = window title and size, e.g. 'Notepad · 800 × 600 px'.
send.clipboard.chosen: Status bar after 전송 when the user chose 'clipboard only' in the target menu.
send.clipboard.noTarget: Editor status message after sending when there is no destination (not detected automatically and none picked). Keep Ctrl+V.
send.clipboard.target: Editor status message after sending when the target cannot be pasted into automatically. {target} = target label. Keep Ctrl+V.
send.failed: Editor status message when sending threw an error. {error} = the error's message.
send.imageNotice: Prefix of the text pasted together with the image into chat apps; tells the agent that the drawn marks in the image are the user's annotations. Read by an AI agent. Keep the square brackets.
send.pasted: Status message after a checked paste followed by the automatic Enter (tray setting). An attempt: never say the AI received, understood or finished anything. {target} = target label.
send.pastedPressEnter: Status message after Ctrl+V went into a checked input field. It is an attempt, not a confirmed delivery: never say 'sent' or 'delivered'. {target} = target label.
send.stopped.error: Status message: an unexpected error stopped the paste; the package is saved and on the clipboard.
send.stopped.focusLost: Status message: another window or element took the keyboard focus right before Ctrl+V; nothing was pasted.
send.stopped.notEditable: Status message: the focused element in the target is not a text input; the clipboard holds the package. {target} = target label.
send.stopped.passwordField: Status message: the focused element is a password field, so Backseat never pastes there.
send.stopped.pasteUnsupported: Status message: macOS / Linux builds cannot paste automatically, so the capture was only put on the clipboard. Keep Cmd+V (macOS) and Ctrl+V (Linux).
send.stopped.targetChanged: Status message: the target browser tab / window title changed (maybe another page or chat), so Backseat stopped before pasting. {target} = target label.
send.stopped.targetExpired: Status message: the target window closed (or its app restarted) before pasting; the package is saved and on the clipboard. {target} = target label.
send.stopped.uiaUnavailable: Status message: Windows accessibility (UI Automation) did not answer, so the input box could not be checked.
send.targetExpired: Status bar after 전송 when the window picked in the target menu has closed; nothing was written or sent. {target} = that window's label.
stt.cloudTranscribing: Editor status bar; {api} = API base URL
stt.noCloudKey: Error in the editor status bar; ': BACKSEAT_STT_API_KEY' is appended
stt.stopped: Error text for a job that was pending when speech recognition was shut down.
stt.workerExited: Error text when the speech recognition worker process exits during a job; shown after 'Speech recognition failed:'. {code} = exit code number.
timeline.clock.live: Timeline clock while not scrubbing. {now} = current editor time (e.g. 0:12.3), {total} = end time of the last annotation. LIVE is a fixed label (keep it).
timeline.hint.linkDrag: Hint line at the right of the timeline toolbar while the user drags a speech line (to link it to an annotation). Esc is a key name; keep it.
timeline.lane.pen: Timeline lane label (freehand strokes), drawn in 10 px text at the left of a 16 px high lane. Very short.
timeline.lane.shape: Timeline lane label for arrows, rectangles, numbered badges and blur regions. Very short (about 6 characters).
timeline.lane.text: Timeline lane label for text annotations. Very short.
timeline.lane.voice: Timeline lane label for the speech/recording lane (transcribed speech lines). Very short.
tray.about: Tray item: opens the About window
tray.briefInEnglish: Tray checkbox: brief.md and the pasted instruction are always English
tray.captureRegion: Tray menu item, followed by a tab and the hotkey
tray.captureWindow: Tray menu item, followed by the hotkey
tray.language: Tray submenu title; ' / Language' is appended automatically in non-English UIs
tray.languageAuto: Language submenu: follow the Windows display language
tray.launchAtLoginDev: Tray checkbox, disabled in a development run
tray.pressEnter: Tray checkbox: press Enter in the agent window after pasting
tray.recaptureLast: Tray menu item: capture the same region again (for before/after comparison)
tray.settingsSaveFailed: Tray balloon text when settings could not be saved. {error} = system error message.
tray.settingsSaveFailedTitle: Title of the tray balloon when config.json could not be written.
tray.sttDetect: Speech language submenu: Whisper detects the language
tray.sttLanguage: Tray submenu title: language for speech recognition
tray.support: Tray item: opens the donation page
tray.target: Tray submenu: which window the next captures are sent to.
tray.target.auto: Tray radio item: no fixed choice, send to the AI window the user used last.
tray.target.current: Tray, first line of the Send to submenu (disabled). {label} = target label, e.g. "Codex · ChatGPT app".
tray.target.noAgents: Tray, disabled line in the Send to submenu when no AI app window is open.
tray.target.none: Tray, first line of the Send to submenu when no safe target exists.
tray.target.otherWindows: Tray submenu with every other open window (messengers, web pages); only used when the user picks one.
tray.target.pin: Tray item: remember the current target for future sends. {label} = target label.
tray.target.pinNone: Tray item (disabled) when there is no target to pin.
uiux.agent.overviewArrived: Status line when a project_overview job result was validated and stored.
uiux.check.contrast.dangerBackground: Name of a contrast check in the design checks list of the UI/UX panel; the measured ratio (like 4.52:1) is shown next to it with pass or fail. 4.5:1 is the WCAG limit for normal text, 3:1 for large text and non-text parts. Keep the numbers.
uiux.check.contrast.infoBackground: Name of a contrast check in the design checks list of the UI/UX panel; the measured ratio (like 4.52:1) is shown next to it with pass or fail. 4.5:1 is the WCAG limit for normal text, 3:1 for large text and non-text parts. Keep the numbers.
uiux.check.contrast.onPrimaryPrimary: Name of a contrast check in the design checks list of the UI/UX panel; the measured ratio (like 4.52:1) is shown next to it with pass or fail. 4.5:1 is the WCAG limit for normal text, 3:1 for large text and non-text parts. Keep the numbers.
uiux.check.contrast.primaryBackground: Name of a contrast check in the design checks list of the UI/UX panel; the measured ratio (like 4.52:1) is shown next to it with pass or fail. 4.5:1 is the WCAG limit for normal text, 3:1 for large text and non-text parts. Keep the numbers.
uiux.check.contrast.successBackground: Name of a contrast check in the design checks list of the UI/UX panel; the measured ratio (like 4.52:1) is shown next to it with pass or fail. 4.5:1 is the WCAG limit for normal text, 3:1 for large text and non-text parts. Keep the numbers.
uiux.check.contrast.textBackground: Name of a contrast check in the design checks list of the UI/UX panel; the measured ratio (like 4.52:1) is shown next to it with pass or fail. 4.5:1 is the WCAG limit for normal text, 3:1 for large text and non-text parts. Keep the numbers.
uiux.check.contrast.textMutedBackground: Name of a contrast check in the design checks list of the UI/UX panel; the measured ratio (like 4.52:1) is shown next to it with pass or fail. 4.5:1 is the WCAG limit for normal text, 3:1 for large text and non-text parts. Keep the numbers.
uiux.check.contrast.textMutedSurface: Name of a contrast check in the design checks list of the UI/UX panel; the measured ratio (like 4.52:1) is shown next to it with pass or fail. 4.5:1 is the WCAG limit for normal text, 3:1 for large text and non-text parts. Keep the numbers.
uiux.check.contrast.textSurface: Name of a contrast check in the design checks list of the UI/UX panel; the measured ratio (like 4.52:1) is shown next to it with pass or fail. 4.5:1 is the WCAG limit for normal text, 3:1 for large text and non-text parts. Keep the numbers.
uiux.check.contrast.warningBackground: Name of a contrast check in the design checks list of the UI/UX panel; the measured ratio (like 4.52:1) is shown next to it with pass or fail. 4.5:1 is the WCAG limit for normal text, 3:1 for large text and non-text parts. Keep the numbers.
uiux.compare.big: Button that opens the large comparison.
uiux.compare.big.tip: Tooltip of the button that opens the large comparison.
uiux.compare.candidateAria: Accessible name of a candidate tab. {label} = A, B, C...; {name} = the proposal name.
uiux.compare.changes.areas: Line above the change list. {areas} = comma-separated area names.
uiux.compare.changes.more: Shown when the change list is cut. {n} = number of hidden changes.
uiux.compare.changes.none: Shown when a candidate changes nothing.
uiux.compare.check.runtime: Tag on a check that can only be done in the running app.
uiux.compare.direction: Chip on a candidate. {direction} = A (minimal change), B (balanced), C (another direction) or free text from the agent.
uiux.compare.empty: Shown instead of any preview when there are no proposals. A generic example is never shown as a candidate.
uiux.compare.locks.restored: Warning above the list of restored token paths.
uiux.compare.mix.locksKept: Note under the mix result; shown only when locks exist.
uiux.compare.mix.name: Name of the proposal the user mixed.
uiux.compare.mix.rationale: Rationale text stored with the mixed proposal. {parts} = e.g. 색상 A, 글꼴 B.
uiux.compare.mix.request: Button: make a UI/UX request from the mix.
uiux.compare.mix.request.tip: Tooltip of the mix request button.
uiux.compare.mix.source: Label above the per-area selectors; also part of their accessible names.
uiux.compare.mix.source.base: Selector option: do not take this area from any candidate.
uiux.compare.mix.stale: Notice: the mix matches no proposal image (spec 8.2).
uiux.compare.mix.title: Heading of the mix tab.
uiux.compare.mockupAlt: Alt text of a mock-up image. {name} = proposal name.
uiux.compare.mockupBeforeRestore: Shown under a mock-up whose proposal tried to change locked values.
uiux.compare.mockupLabel: Label of a mock-up image (spec 8.1). Always shown with the image.
uiux.compare.mockupMissing: Shown above the samples when the agent promised a mock-up but none arrived.
uiux.compare.noOriginal: Shown where the original would be.
uiux.compare.none: Value text: a shadow that is switched off.
uiux.compare.origin.agent: Chip: the candidate came from the connected AI.
uiux.compare.origin.builtin: Chip: the candidate came from Backseat's own rules.
uiux.compare.origin.user: Chip: the candidate was mixed by the user.
uiux.compare.originalAlt: Alt text of the original capture image.
uiux.compare.outdated: Warning chip: the candidate was made for an older project overview than the current one.
uiux.compare.overlay.candidate: Accessible name of the candidate list in the large comparison.
uiux.compare.overlay.noMockup: Shown in the large comparison where the candidate image would be.
uiux.compare.overlay.title: Title and accessible name of the large comparison window.

uiux.rp.check.focus: Checklist item that needs the running app.
uiux.rp.check.responsive: Checklist item that needs the running app.
uiux.rp.claim: Shown above the report: a claim, not proof.
uiux.rp.confirm: Button: the user confirms they looked at the result.
uiux.rp.recapture: Hint: how to verify on a new capture.
uiux.rp.runtime: Suffix of a checklist item that needs the running app.
uiux.rp.step.confirmed: Progress step: the user confirmed on a new capture.
uiux.rp.step.received: Progress step: the agent submitted its implementation report.
uiux.rp.title: Panel section: the implementation report after a send with UI/UX guidance.
uiux.rp.visual: Suffix of a checklist item that a capture can show.
uiux.samples.card.body: Body paragraph of the sample card; drawn with the body font.
uiux.samples.card.specimen: Font specimen: Hangul, Latin and digits together. Keep the Hangul in every language so a missing Hangul glyph shows (spec 7.3).
uiux.samples.card.title: Heading inside the sample card; drawn with the heading font.
uiux.samples.fonts.differs: The requested font is not installed, so another one is drawn. Both placeholders are font names.
uiux.samples.fonts.noKorean: The font in use has no Korean characters; the system draws them with a different font.
uiux.samples.fonts.role.body: Text role name in the font list.
uiux.samples.fonts.role.heading: Text role name in the font list.
uiux.samples.fonts.role.numeric: Text role name in the font list.
uiux.samples.fonts.same: Font in use when it is the requested one. {family} is a font name.
uiux.samples.fonts.title: Heading of the list saying which font each text role was really drawn with.
uiux.samples.input.hint: Help bubble under the sample field; also shows the popover shadow.
uiux.samples.input.label: Label of the sample text field.
uiux.samples.input.placeholder: Placeholder of the sample text field.
uiux.samples.label: Label above the component samples. Always visible so the samples never pass for the real app (spec 8.1).
uiux.samples.notReal: Short note next to the label.
uiux.samples.ratio.label: Label of the bar showing the intended share of background, surface and accent. A target, not a measurement (spec 7.3).
uiux.samples.ratio.legend: Percent shares next to the target ratio bar. Placeholders are whole numbers.
uiux.samples.referenceNote: Shown only when a reference image is placed behind the samples.
uiux.samples.status.danger: Status chip text for the danger colour, shown with a cross glyph.
uiux.samples.status.info: Status chip text, shown with an info glyph.
uiux.samples.status.success: Status chip text, shown with a check glyph.
uiux.samples.status.warning: Status chip text, shown with a triangle glyph.
uiux.samples.table.amount: Sample table column header for a sum; right-aligned numbers.
uiux.samples.table.label: Accessible name of the sample table (not visible).
uiux.samples.table.qty: Sample table column header for a count; right-aligned numbers.
uiux.sk.askAgain: Button: capabilities job when a list exists.
uiux.sk.missing: Fields the skill needs that the agent could not find.
uiux.sk.none: Hint when no agent skills are known.
uiux.sk.ready: The skill's project info is stored.
uiux.sk.refresh: Button: skill_setup job when the skill was prepared before.
uiux.sk.runsAtAgent: Hint under a chosen agent skill.
uiux.sk.setup: Button: skill_setup job — the agent gathers what the skill needs about the project.
uiux.suggest.alignEdges: Memo suggestion chip in the UI/UX panel; clicking it inserts this sentence into the note for the agent. Shown when the user drew a rectangle or an arrow. Phrase it as a polite request.
uiux.suggest.alignNumbersRight: Memo suggestion chip in the UI/UX panel; clicking it inserts this sentence into the note for the agent. General suggestion, shown when nothing more specific applies. Phrase it as a polite request.
uiux.suggest.cardShadow: Memo suggestion chip in the UI/UX panel; clicking it inserts this sentence into the note for the agent. Shown when the project rules define a card shadow. Phrase it as a polite request.
uiux.suggest.contrastAccent: Memo suggestion chip in the UI/UX panel; clicking it inserts this sentence into the note for the agent. Shown when the accent or a status colour fails its contrast check. Phrase it as a polite request.
uiux.suggest.contrastButton: Memo suggestion chip in the UI/UX panel; clicking it inserts this sentence into the note for the agent. Shown when the text on the accent colour fails its contrast check. Phrase it as a polite request.
uiux.suggest.contrastText: Memo suggestion chip in the UI/UX panel; clicking it inserts this sentence into the note for the agent. Shown when body or muted text fails its contrast check. Phrase it as a polite request.
uiux.suggest.equalSpacing: Memo suggestion chip in the UI/UX panel; clicking it inserts this sentence into the note for the agent. Shown when the user drew a rectangle or an arrow. Phrase it as a polite request.
uiux.suggest.followRules: Memo suggestion chip in the UI/UX panel; clicking it inserts this sentence into the note for the agent. Shown when the project has saved design rules. Phrase it as a polite request.
uiux.suggest.followSkill: Memo suggestion chip in the UI/UX panel; clicking it inserts this sentence into the note for the agent. Shown when the project uses a design skill other than the built-in one. Placeholders: {skill} = skill name, not translated. Phrase it as a polite request.
uiux.suggest.keepBrandColor: Memo suggestion chip in the UI/UX panel; clicking it inserts this sentence into the note for the agent. Shown when the project locked its colours. Phrase it as a polite request.
uiux.suggest.keepFont: Memo suggestion chip in the UI/UX panel; clicking it inserts this sentence into the note for the agent. Shown when the project rules define a body font. Placeholders: {font} = font name, not translated. Phrase it as a polite request.
uiux.suggest.keepGap: Memo suggestion chip in the UI/UX panel; clicking it inserts this sentence into the note for the agent. Shown when the project rules define a gap. Placeholders: {gap} = CSS px number. Phrase it as a polite request.
uiux.suggest.keepHidden: Memo suggestion chip in the UI/UX panel; clicking it inserts this sentence into the note for the agent. Shown when the user blurred part of the capture. Phrase it as a polite request.
uiux.suggest.keepLocked: Memo suggestion chip in the UI/UX panel; clicking it inserts this sentence into the note for the agent. Shown when the project has locked design values. Phrase it as a polite request.
uiux.suggest.keepWording: Memo suggestion chip in the UI/UX panel; clicking it inserts this sentence into the note for the agent. General suggestion. Phrase it as a polite request.
uiux.suggest.lineHeight: Memo suggestion chip in the UI/UX panel; clicking it inserts this sentence into the note for the agent. Shown when the user drew a text annotation. Phrase it as a polite request.
uiux.suggest.noCardShadow: Memo suggestion chip in the UI/UX panel; clicking it inserts this sentence into the note for the agent. Shown when the project rules use flat cards. Phrase it as a polite request.
uiux.suggest.noNewColors: Memo suggestion chip in the UI/UX panel; clicking it inserts this sentence into the note for the agent. General suggestion. Phrase it as a polite request.
uiux.suggest.onlyMarked: Memo suggestion chip in the UI/UX panel; clicking it inserts this sentence into the note for the agent. Shown when the user drew with the pen. Phrase it as a polite request.
uiux.suggest.onlyNumbered: Memo suggestion chip in the UI/UX panel; clicking it inserts this sentence into the note for the agent. Shown when the user placed number badges. Phrase it as a polite request.
uiux.suggest.sameRadius: Memo suggestion chip in the UI/UX panel; clicking it inserts this sentence into the note for the agent. General suggestion. Phrase it as a polite request.
uiux.suggest.textSize: Memo suggestion chip in the UI/UX panel; clicking it inserts this sentence into the note for the agent. Shown when the user drew a text annotation. Phrase it as a polite request.
